verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily data exports to a destination of choice and revenue exports for financial systems, showing some data portability, but there is no evidence of exporting *all* account data, no mention of open/standard formats (CSV/JSON), and no documented account-closure or full-export workflow for a user wanting to fully leave the platform. missing for 10: explicit open-format specification, full-account export scope, and independent confirmation of export completeness.
